newsitem.title: USA: Rada Electronic settles holder dispute.
newsitem.headline: Rada Electronic settles holder dispute.

text.p: Rada Electronic Industries Ltd said Tuesday it settled a shareholder dispute allowing its annual meeting to be reconvened as an adjourned meeting.
The settlement adds two directors, nominated by the dissadents, to Rada's board, the company said.
As a result of the settlement, Imaginative Business & Marketing Ltd withdrew its motion for injunction, filed with the district court of Tel Aviv, Rada said.
It said Imaginative Business and International Publishing Holding s.a. also withdrew their request for an extraordinary meeting of shareholders.
The agreement with IPH / IB&M stipulates, among other things, that Rada appoint two additional directors to its seven members board, to be proposed by IPH / IB&M.
Rada said the two sides have agreed to enter into cooperative relationship and work together on the board level, with a view toward improving shareholder value.
The various items that were brought forward by IPH / IB&M in the settled dispute will be dealt with by the new board, trying to obtain positive results on a timely basis.
